action.apps.winget-upgrade.desc: Upgrades only the packages you ticked in the winget updates list, one at a time, silently (accepts the source and package agreements). Never uses --all. Machine-wide installers may show a UAC prompt. Blocked on managed devices: in companies, IT updates software. Cannot be undone by WinCare.
action.apps.store-reset.desc: Resets the selected Microsoft Store app (Reset-AppxPackage). WARNING: deletes all the app's local data (settings, sign-in, cached files) and returns it to its first-run state. Requires Windows 10 2004 or Windows 11. Cannot be undone.
action.apps.open-repair.desc: Opens Settings > Apps. There, pick the app > Modify/Repair (or Advanced options > Repair for Store apps). WinCare never runs uninstallers or repairs by itself.
section.apps.installed.note: Read from the registry Uninstall keys (machine 64/32-bit and current user). The Executable column shows only the uninstaller program, without arguments. System components and updates are hidden.
section.apps.broken-uninstall.note: The registered uninstaller no longer exists on disk. The program may have been deleted by hand. WinCare only reports this: it does not remove registry entries.
section.apps.winget-updates.note: Result of 'winget upgrade --include-unknown'. Tick the packages you want to upgrade and use the action below.
section.apps.winget-updates.note.none: winget found no updates for the installed programs.
section.apps.winget-updates.note.partial: Some lines of the winget table could not be read safely and were skipped (e.g. names with wide characters). Check with 'winget upgrade' in a terminal.
section.apps.winget-updates.note.failed: winget failed to list updates. See the code and message below.
section.apps.winget-updates.note.not-fou: winget was not found for this user. It ships with App Installer from the Microsoft Store; on corporate machines IT may block it.
section.apps.winget-updates.note.system-: WinCare is running as SYSTEM. winget normally works only in the signed-in user's account; open WinCare in your own session to see updates.
section.apps.store-problems.note: Current-user packages whose status is not Ok (e.g. Modified, Tampered, LicenseIssue, NeedsRemediation). Read-only. To try a fix, use Open app repair or Reset Store app.
